section.37: The Book of Fighting [The Prohibition of Bloodshed]

37.name_native: The Book of Fighting [The Prohibition of Bloodshed]

hadiths.text: It was narrated that An-Nu'man bin Salim said:"I heard Aws say: 'The Messenger of Allah [SAW] came to us when we were in a tent.'" And he quoted the same Hadith
